notes.title: Update 1.1.0, Japanese and Portuguese available + bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello nightshifters 👻🔦!

Paranormal Night Shift version 1.1.0 is now available! 

What's new in this release ?

✅ Support for two new languages: Japanese 🇯🇵 and Portuguese 🇧🇷, thanks to Yui and Luana for their great work!
✅ Shorter time for the endgame sequence (due to a widespread demand 😄). 
✅ Added A and D keys in addition to directional keys to quickly switch cameras.
✅ Minor bug fixes
✅ Translation bug fixes

Thank you all for your support and feedback! Feel free to share your impressions on Discord and leave a review on Steam! 

Jordi

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hi nightshifters!

I've just released version 1.0.9, which contains the following fixes:

- Fixed a bug that prevented the end sequence from being skipped
- Changed intro and credits music

Thank you all for your feedback!

Jordi

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hi Nightshifters!

I just wanted to say a big thanks to all of you for the support and super cool feedback I've received following the release of Paranormal Night Shift! 

It's been 4 weeks now since Paranormal Night Shift was released and it's time to patch the little bugs that some of you have spotted.

This version 1.0.8 contains the following fixes:

- Fixed untranslated text at the end of the first night
- Fixed some Spanish and Russian translations
- Added volume control in settings
- Changed the music in the cutscene between night 2 and night 3
- Added a link to the discord in the menu

I've created a discord server for the game, so feel free to leave your comments and suggestions there. There are also spaces dedicated to translations, so if you see any errors, don't hesitate to report them!

Cheers 
Jordi
